headline: Chile 2027 GDP Growth Consensus Forecasts Fall Below 3%
summary: Consensus forecasts for Chile's 2027 GDP growth dropped, with nearly half of surveyed economic entities projecting growth below 3% amid labor and mining risks.
why: Macroeconomic growth projections influence central bank policy, sovereign debt valuations, and corporate investment planning in Latin America.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Downward revisions in GDP growth expectations reflect economic slowing.
